subject: general
question: How many medal(s) did India win in the World Athletics Championship 2022?
solution:
The correct answer is __**1**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• At the **World Athletics Championships 2022,** India was represented by a total of **22 athletes**, comprising **18 men and four women.** Despite the modest representation, India managed to secure only one medal.
 
• **Neeraj Chopra **emerged as the sole medalist for India, clinching the Silver medal in Javelin Throw with an impressive throw of 88.13 meters.
 
• The Gold medal in Javelin Throw was claimed by Anderson Peters of Grenada, who achieved a throw of 90.54 meters.
 
• The championship, originally scheduled for 2021, was postponed due to the COVID-19 pandemic.
 
• It marked the 18th edition of the World Athletics Championships and was held in Eugene, Oregon, United States.
 
• The event's motto was **"Feel the Glory." **The United States dominated the medal tally, securing a total of 33 medals, including 13 Gold medals.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

__
 
• **The World Athletics Championship 2023** marked the 19th edition of the event. It took place in Budapest, Hungary, from August 19th to August 27th, 2023.
 
• Notably, Neeraj Chopra secured India's only medal at the event, winning a gold in the men's javelin throw competition.
 
• This achievement made Neeraj Chopra the first Indian athlete to become a world champion in athletics.
 
• In terms of the medal tally, the United States topped the charts with a total of 29 medals, comprising 12 Gold, 8 Silver, and 9 Bronze.
 
• Canada secured the second position in the medal tally, while India finished in the 18th position overall.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **The World Athletics Championships **is a biennial athletics competition organized by World Athletics. 
 
• Inaugurated in** 1983**, the championships were initially held every four years until 1991 when it transitioned to a two-year cycle.
